notes.title: Added support for Valve Index and VIVE
notes.content: The Lineindevs team has added support for the Valve Index and VIVE controllers! In the discussions, the players wrote to us that not everyone has the Oculus Rift, they need support from other controllers. We understand this, and wanted to release the game with support for all popular controllers, but a week before the game went into Early Access, we figured out that we needed to improve the controls on Valve Index and VIVE. We finally did it)) Hopefully players with Index and VIVE controllers will be happy to play JEI VR in and give us feedback in our community. Together we will make a cool game
